Singleton restricts a class to one instance; use sparingly.
Factory methods create objects without exposing construction logic.
Observer notifies dependents when state changes.
Strategy swaps algorithms behind a common interface.
Adapter translates one interface into another.
Decorator adds behavior without modifying the original class.
Repository abstracts data access behind a collection-like interface.
